summary: The discussion centers on the ambiguity that arises when a FILE logical type value contains both inline data and a URI locator, which can lead to different readers returning different bytes. Participants propose that the inline bytes should win, treating locator fields as provenance only, and that this change would not invalidate existing data. Participants suggest updating the guide to remove the fixed recommendation and provide guidance on selecting page sizes based on workload and storage type. The proposal introduces a SERIALIZED_VALUE logical type for Parquet BYTE_ARRAY columns that records the serialization format and schema of messages such as protobuf, FlatBuffers, or Thrift.
